# EMVA GenTL reference header

GenTL.h is the unmodified GenTL 1.6 reference header (2004–2019 GenICam GenTL Subcommittee).
Downloaded 2026-10-07 from https://www.emva.org/wp-content/uploads/GenTL_v1_6.zip
via the official https://www.emva.org/standards-technology/genicam/genicam-downloads-archive/ page.
SHA256 (GenTL.h): 5b656a413f4cdc347e80494b87f94b09ac925e391a9022edb7f028d996e35e4e.

Copyright and disclaimer are preserved in the header. The GenICam license is available at
https://www.emva.org/wp-content/uploads/GenICam_License_20231009.pdf .
See license.txt for the redistribution conditions accompanying this copy.
No GenApi runtime or vendor driver is included. This project does not claim GenICam certification.
